text: Reworked compressed ReducedRankGls toward fmrireg parity. The shared-GLS compressed path now derives the immutable voxel basis from the whitened design QR and leading Q^T Y SVD, then solves truncated score targets back through the design QR before chunk-local decoding. Added a hard fmrireg QR-SVD rank-one fixture and regression coverage for coefficients/residual variances; updated fit README to record the all-predictor Scala boundary and remaining event/nuisance split. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 125/120; final sbt modelJVM/test modelJS/test fitJVM/test fitJS/test passed 16/16/125/120; scoped git diff --check clean; explicit trailing-whitespace scan clean for untracked ReducedRankGls/fixture files. Remaining: typed event-vs-nuisance reduced-rank target roles, energy/RSS rank policies, bootstrap/task-only inference policy, and voxelwise-AR compressed RRG.
